contract.hypothesis: Small confirmation from same-company reported annual operating-margin improvement can distinguish durable long-term momentum.
contract.measurement: Candidate=sign(OI_current/Revenue_current - OI_comparative/Revenue_comparative); control=sign(OI_current/days_current - OI_comparative/days_comparative), exact rational signs from the SAME annual consolidated report.
contract.availability: Latest report known at signal close using publication-next-session clock; max400 calendar days inclusive since known_session; no fallback from held latest report. Both annual periods must have330..400days, positive revenue and finite signed OI. AAPL FY2016 unknown comparative start stays unavailable. Other companies/ETFs neutral.
contract.scoring: Add fixed0.01*sign to frozen Local67 pre-score then exactly one original episode. No cross-sectional re-ranking of signs, no eligibility filter in feature computation; first partial allocation gets zero delta.
contract.portfolio: Unchanged long-momentum main score, skip42 core, historical proxy Top32+theme17, original eligibility and EW3/two halves/under2 cash. Fixed adjusted units intramonth; difference rebalance, no terminal liquidation.
contract.limitation: Conditional historical research, reused development sample and estimated membership; retrospectively retrieved original-dated documents, no pristine first-public archive or complete amendment history. Same-table currency units cancel in ratios, ISO not inferred. Reported margin is affected by acquisitions, disposals, FX and accounting estimates; not organic or constant-scope profitability.
contract.historical_best_tracking: First88-only frozen selection. Historical best uses full-period descriptive performance among training-selected candidates, not independent validation or observer promotion.
